'''''Andropogon distachyos''''' is a species of perennial herb in the family [[Poaceae]] (true grasses). They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 62 cm.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Andropogon distachyos L., nom. cons. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5796827|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Andropogon distachyos (Bluestem Grass) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/POAC/Andropogon_distachyos.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
